C0373.title: Brute-Force Attacks on SMS Verification Codes for IoT Device Account Takeover
C0373.summary: A 2018 academic paper identifies a vulnerability in the password reset mechanism of IoT device accounts that relies on SMS verification codes. Attackers can use automated tools to brute-force the SMS codes and gain unauthorized account access. The study develops an automation tool to demonstrate account takeover by brute-forcing SMS verification codes.

references.title: Cracking IoT Device User Account via Brute-force Attack to SMS
